notes.title: Lands Of The Lost - Steam Bound !!!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32840178/7047d1e863820e1d8ea04e179c4560105f574a82.png[/img]

The excitement is palpable as Lands Of The Lost, the first title from Night Owl Gaming LLC is set to arrive on Steam!

A lot of hard work went into this game over the course of a year (especially into the random world generation system) and hopefully it shows.

Will you answer the call to save the lands?
